KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
Group/Division
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America.
Job
Description/Preferred
Qualifications
Responsibilities
Develop, optimize, and qualify system calibrations, health checks, and diagnostic methodologies to ensure consistent tool performance across engineering, manufacturing, and customer sites.
Own characterization and continuous improvement of optical subsystems including focus modules, illumination systems, image acquisition systems. Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for optical performance issues.
Lead technical investigations for critical customer escalations, coordinate cross-functional root-cause analyses, develop corrective action plans, and provide expert-level support to Field Service, Applications, and Customer Support teams.
Support NPI activities including engineering builds, beta installations, field qualification, performance validation, and customer pilot deployments. Work closely with software, mechanical, applications, and service teams to ensure successful product introduction.
Develop diagnostic tools, data analysis utilities, scripts, and automation workflows to improve troubleshooting efficiency, characterization quality, and engineering productivity.
Be an agent of change: The semiconductor industry is a fast-paced industry with constant change and ever-increasing speed of new product introductions.
The successful candidate is expected to adopt and drive new ideas and new ways of doing things in a fast moving and highly competitive industry. This is high-visibility role.
Preferred Qualifications
Masters or PhD in Physics, Optics Engineering, Mechanical, Electrical or related fields with at least 3-5 years of work experience.
Ability to work effectively with little supervision and achieve results in a timely manner
Experience with MATLAB, Python, scripting, statistical analysis, and engineering automation tools.
Effective communicator with good interpersonal skills. Ideally, have strong experience in managing and messaging to customers and Executives.
Proven track record of technical issues resolution. Good problem solver who works well as part of a focused team.
Experience developing, integrating, troubleshooting, or supporting complex opto-mechanical, electromechanical, or semiconductor capital equipment systems.
Strong fundamentals in optics, microscopy, imaging systems, sensors, motion control, precision positioning systems, automation, and system characterization.
Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes, wafer inspection, defect review, lithography, advanced packaging, metrology, or process control is preferred.
Excellent English communication skills are required. Ability to speak Mandarin is a plus but not necessary.
Minimum Qualifications
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

The SPTS division of KLA, designs, manufactures and markets wafer processing solutions for the global semiconductor and related industries. SPTS provides industry leading etch and deposition process technologies on a range of single wafer handling platforms. End-market applications include micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS), advanced packaging, LED, high speed RF device IC’s and power semiconductors. SPTS is part of KLA Corporation which develops industry-leading equipment and services that enable innovation throughout the electronics industry. We provide advanced process control and process-enabling solutions for manufacturing wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. SPTS is headquartered and has its main manufacturing facility in Newport, UK, with additional manufacturing in Allentown, Pennsylvania. SPTS operates across 19 countries in Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific, and offers comprehensive service and spare parts support through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.

Additional responsibilities include providing customer technical support, preparing technical reports for internal and external stakeholders, generating intellectual property submissions, and supporting other business units as required.
This position will involve some international travel (subject to business requirements) to support customer installations and development activities. Occasional shift work may also be required.

Process Demonstrations
Develop and demonstrate plasma etch processes to meet agreed specifications.
Assess results using analytical equipment and relevant software tools.
Perform process troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
Provide regular updates to Product Management on demonstration and sample work.
Build and maintain effective relationships with customers and the global KLA support network.
Summarise findings through technical reports and presentations.
Process Development
Develop and optimise processes across SPTS product platforms.
Plan and execute work safely, efficiently, and to agreed timescales.
Utilise endpoint detection techniques to enhance process control and performance.
Conduct long-duration testing for new processes and equipment.
Contribute to cross-functional projects supporting new products and technologies.
Prepare technical reports to support patent applications, publications, and conferences.
Field Support
Develop and optimise SPTS processes to meet customer requirements at customer sites.
Provide factory-based technical support to field teams and customers.
Establish and maintain strong customer relationships through effective technical support.
Key Skills and Experience
The successful candidate will have:
Experience of plasma etch processing within a semiconductor environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience with semiconductor metrology techniques.
SEM experience would be advantageous, although training can be provided.
Knowledge and practical experience of endpoint detection techniques.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
The ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

Cash health plan

Global bonus plan

The TSE responds to complex issues when first-line product support has been unable to isolate or resolve problems with malfunctioning equipment. This position is responsible for providing advanced technical troubleshooting, managing equipment escalations, developing corrective action plans, and working cross-functionally with field service, engineering, product support, and customer teams to restore equipment performance and minimize production impact. The successful candidate will bring strong analytical capability, hands-on technical expertise, and professional communication skills to a fast-paced semiconductor fab environment.

Analyze tool data, inspection reports, system logs, diagnostic results, and customer observations to determine root cause and recommend effective corrective actions.

Support onsite customer escalations, including troubleshooting, corrective actions, recovery activities, and post-repair verification.
Collaborate with Customer Service Engineers, Technical Support Managers, product engineers, design engineering, software teams, and regional experts to resolve escalations efficiently.
Lead or support service alert and escalation meetings, track open actions, and provide timely technical updates to service management and customer-facing teams.
Prepare professional service reports, escalation summaries, postmortem reports, and structured problem-solving documentation.
Capture lessons learned and develop best-known methods, troubleshooting procedures, training materials, and technical documentation for regional service teams.
Support equipment installations, upgrades, customer acceptance activities, and production ramp readiness where technical support expertise is required.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve product reliability, maintainability, serviceability, and training, and by providing feedback to the appropriate engineering or support organization.

Company Overview
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
Group/Division
The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.
Job
Description/Preferred
Qualifications
Will be in charge of FaST product
Primarily responsible for installation activities associated with modifying, troubleshooting, diagnosing and repairing of highly complex capital equipment at customer sites
Evaluates, analyzes, diagnoses and troubleshoots technical equipment problems via telephone or at customer site
Assures operational quality of system equipment. Coordinates actions with customers to minimize down time.
Prepares fields service reports on customer support activity and provides documentation to other supporting functions on re-occurring problems
Assists other field service engineers as appropriate
Contribute to the Capturing, Re-use, Collaboration, and Improvement of knowledge using available systems
Minimum Qualifications
3+ years Semiconductor, Automotive, or Medical equipment service support experience preferred
Willing to travel ~80%
Language skill in English: ability to read and understand procedures/technical documents, ability to understand training carried out in English
Native (or business level) Japanese

jobs.title: Regional Development Applications Engineer (SPTS)
jobs.description:
Company Overview
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
Group/Division
SPTS wafer processing solutions include market-leading silicon etch, dielectric etch, dry-release etch, PVD, PECVD and molecular vapor deposition (MVD®), available with a range of wafer-handling options applicable to R&D, pilot production, or volume production environments. SPTS is headquartered and has its main manufacturing facility in Newport, UK, with additional manufacturing in Allentown, Pennsylvania. SPTS operates across 19 countries in Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific, and offers comprehensive service and spare parts support through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.
Job
Description/Preferred
Qualifications
Role Description
Working as part of our Etch, CVD, PVD Business unit team, the primary responsibilities of this role will be to perform field engineering & application activities related to PVD semiconductor thin film technology.
This will involve working on several different process module types and a huge range of applications at multiple customer sites, collecting data, investigating problems & generating new processes to meet the customer requirements, as well as an element of hardware testing. Additional responsibilities would include writing technical reports for both internal and external use.
This role will also involve advising both KLA field teams and other members of the team on escalation status, application development and process tuning
This position will be based in Singapore and reporting directly into Snr. Manager RPM. Role will involve travel within Taiwan, UK, US and other countries as needed.
Key Duties
Problem Solving & Trouble Shooting
Supporting key customer escalations in the region
Data collection & analysis, reporting
Detailed problem solving using 8D methodology
Product & Process development
Identifying weaknesses in the product based on customer needs
Develop solutions on site with customers for those needs using existing toolset
Where outside toolset capability, feeding back customer developments, engagement & needs to UK business unit
Develop new processes in line with KLA roadmaps
Plan, work and implement solutions in a safe, logical and timely manner
Tool Qualification
Together with the field team obtaining field acceptance on customer’s sites
Experience directly with PVD, Etch, CVD process development & applications, with some PVD hardware knowledge in semiconductor industry would be highly advantageous.
Ability to communicate clearly in verbal and written forms with HQ engineering teams
Has some industry experience (ideally Semiconductor)
Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent experience) in a chemistry, physics, or other relevant field
A Creative and innovative approach to problem solving leading to novel but practical solutions.
The foresight and ability to collect, filter and analyze data to solve complex problems.
Good analytical skills including the ability to be hands on in fabs, measuring films, coordinating activities from experiment to result & reporting
The ability to work both autonomously and as part of team.
Minimum Qualifications
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

Contribute to the Capturing, Re-use, Collaboration, and Improvement of knowledge using available systems.

Optical, semiconductor, metrology, aerospace, or high-technology equipment

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
Group/Division
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The RAPID division is the world leading provider of reticle inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry. The company provides inspection solutions to both the mask shops and the semiconductor fabs to ensure that lithography yields are consistently high thus enabling cost-effective manufacturing.
Job
Description/Preferred
Qualifications
Job Description
The Advanced Technology of RAPID Division is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineering Manager to lead mechanical development for next-generation EUV light source in the cutting-edge reticle inspection products. This role leads a multidisciplinary mechanical team delivering precision hardware operating in extreme environments including high vacuum, high-power laser, thermal transients, precision opto-mechanics, and precision motion mechanisms.
Responsibilities
Lead and develop a high-performing mechanical engineering team; set technical direction, priorities, and execution plans to deliver on schedule, cost, and quality.
Own mechanical system architecture and delivery for EUV source subsystems including: vacuum chambers and ultra-clean/UHV-compatible hardware; laser/mechanical integration and beam delivery mechanical packaging; collector mirror mounting/alignment mechanisms; plasma target delivery hardware; precision motion components; gas delivery mechanical interfaces; thermal management and structural dynamics.
Drive rigorous design review and release discipline, including requirements definition, tolerance analysis, validation/qualification planning, and documentation quality.
Partner closely with Technology, Optics, Systems, Production Development, Machine Controls, Manufacturing and Service organizations to improve cost, performance, manufacturability, reliability, and serviceability.
Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for complex subsystem issues; implement design improvements that increase availability and uptime.
Manage supplier technical engagement for precision parts and subassemblies, including vendor selection, qualification, and issue resolution.
Embed safety-by-design into mechanical solutions and enable people/machine safety service/production tooling (jigs, fixtures, alignment tools, handling/lifting concepts).
Occasional domestic/international travels may be required to support build/validation and customer-site readiness.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with EUV-adjacent source or illumination subsystems, high-power laser-integrated hardware, or precision opto-mechanical alignment systems.
Experience with cryogenic mechanisms and vacuum feedthroughs/seals designed for reliability and maintainability.
Track record of production transfer and sustaining engineering support (tooling, procedures, and field escalation readiness).
Minimum Qualifications
B.S. in Mechanical Engineering (M.S. preferred) or equivalent related discipline.
10+ years of experience developing complex hardware/capital equipment (semiconductor tools, precision vacuum systems, opto-mechanical equipment, aerospace-grade mechanisms, or similar).
5+ years of people management experience leading engineers through concept-to-release development.
Demonstrated expertise in multiple of: vacuum/UHV design, precision mechanisms, rotating machinery/air bearings, thermal-structural design, vibration/dynamics, contamination-aware mechanical design, and design-for-manufacturability/serviceability.
Strong cross-functional communication and leadership skills; ability to drive alignment across technical stakeholders and suppliers.

The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
Job
Description/Preferred
Qualifications
The Central Engineering Team seeks a Senior Mechanical Engineer to design a next-generation stage design for high-vacuum platforms, meeting demanding ultra-precision and noise-control requirements! As a senior engineer, you will drive stage mechanical design from concept through validation and sustaining, partnering closely with controls, systems, and manufacturing teams to deliver nanometer-level accuracy and stability. If you are energized by solving hard precision- and vacuum-engineering problems for mission-critical semiconductor inspection equipment, we would like to hear from you!
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain the mechanical architecture of next-generation multi-DOF ultra-precision motion stages that operate under high vacuum for eBeam inspection and review, taking the work from concept through detailed design, prototyping, and validation to meet nanometer-level accuracy, stability, and noise-control targets, including:
Multi-degree-of-freedom stage structures, flexures, and precision motion mechanisms.
Vacuum- and UHV-compatible materials and hardware with low-outgassing, contamination-controlled design.
Bearing, guide, and actuation selection such as air bearings, linear guides, and linear motors.
Metrology and feedback integration, including laser interferometers and high-resolution encoders.
Thermal management and drift compensation for stable, repeatable positioning.
Structural dynamics, damping, and vibration/noise isolation.
Design parts and assemblies in Creo/SolidWorks and generate detailed drawings with GD&T, driving rigorous design-review and release discipline from requirements definition through validation and qualification.
Perform structural, thermal, and vibration/modal FEA and tolerance stack-up analysis to optimize stiffness, damping, accuracy, and manufacturability, and build, test, and troubleshoot prototypes — including modal testing with accelerometers and impact hammers — to characterize dynamic performance and correlate models against test data.
Partner closely with controls, systems, and manufacturing engineers to integrate the stage at the subsystem and system level and to improve performance, manufacturability, reliability, and serviceability.
Own supplier technical engagement for precision parts and subassemblies — motors, bearings, encoders, and machined or cast components — including vendor selection, qualification, and issue resolution.
Embed safety-by-design into mechanical solutions and develop service and production tooling such as jigs, fixtures, alignment tools, and handling concepts.
Required Qualifications
Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, with experience in motion systems, precision mechanics, or mechatronics.
Proficiency in Creo/SolidWorks or a similar 3D CAD modeling tool, backed by several years of work experience, along with structural, thermal, and vibration/modal FEA.
Design-for-manufacturing (DFM) experience across machining, sheet metal, and castings; working knowledge of data-analysis tools such as Python or MATLAB.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with feedback systems involving laser interferometers and high-resolution optical encoders, linear motors, linear guides, air bearings, and similar components.
Design experience with dynamic X-Y sub-micron positioning stages, including vibration and modal testing using accelerometers, impact hammers, and comparable instrumentation.
Semiconductor capital-equipment design experience.
Minimum Qualifications
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years

jobs.title: Applications Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
Group/Division
Enabling the movement toward advanced chip design, KLA's Measurement, Analytics and Control group (MACH) is looking for the best and brightest research scientists, software engineers, application development engineers and senior product technology process engineers to join our team. The MACH team's mission is to collaborate with our customers to innovate technologies and solutions that detect and control highly complex process variations—at their source—rather than compensate for them at later stages of the manufacturing process. With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Our MACH team develops leading-edge solutions for patterning process analytics and control technologies, thereby providing customers with critical insight at the feature level, field level and cross-wafer analysis. Our teams also develop advanced modeling simulation, data analytics and process control modeling technologies. As a member of the MACH team, you’ll be joining the most sophisticated and successful process-control company in the semiconductor industry--working across functions to solve the most complex technical problems in the digital age.

Qualifications
Strong technical capabilities with a focus on the ability to code in C++ or python. Strong logical thinking and communication skills. Travel will exceed 70%.
